summary: Full e2e testing of BPO QA Analyzer MVP. All 9 backend pytest tests passed (root, analyze validation, analyze full-schema with real GPT-5.2, list, get-404, analytics summary, upload-transcript, delete + delete-404). Frontend tested end-to-end: homepage with 3 tabs, Load Sample populated transcript, Analyze Call triggered LLM (~15s), EvaluationView rendered with QA score 8, sentiment=negative, risk=high, escalation, score breakdown bars, History tab listed new evaluations, Analytics tab rendered total_calls, avg scores, sentiment pie, risk bar, top compliance issues, QA score trend.

issues: QA score is 0-100 but gauge arc rendering for low scores (e.g. 8) shows very small red sliver; consider clearer scale labeling. Minor cosmetic.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown') - prefer lifespan context manager (non-blocking).
extract_json may still fail for nested braces in ideal_response strings; current implementation works for current LLM outputs but could be hardened with a stack-based parser.
No backend test for /api/upload-transcript with non-utf8 binary - graceful but untested.
No pagination on /api/evaluations beyond limit=50 default; fine for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Test created 1 evaluation 'TEST_Agent_Rude' via analyze, then deleted it during delete test. Other manual test evaluations (Unknown Agent, Test Agent) remain in DB from frontend testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All endpoints and UI flows verified working. Real GPT-5.2 LLM calls take ~10-20s. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_bpo_qa.py is reusable as regression suite. data-testid attributes properly wired (tab-analyzer/history/analytics, load-sample-btn, analyze-call-button, transcript-textarea, evaluation-view, qa-score-value).
